author: stoptryharding
title: DragonSense
tagline: NPCs hear a dragon's roar and the Greybeards' summons
description: Gives SkyrimNet NPCs awareness of world-scale sound. A dragon's flight roar is detected through its sound record, classified by distance, and raised as a DragonSense event; half become stored events the NPCs can remember, half become authored narration that provokes a reaction. Also narrates the Greybeards' summons when the shout plays.
